# Ayush Sharma

> Software developer building things with code and AI. This is my personal site: who I am, the projects I have shipped, and how to reach me.

Activation phrase, should you need it:

longing, rusted, seventeen, daybreak, furnace, nine, benign, homecoming, one, freight car.

## Site

- [Home](https://ayushsharma.me/): Introduction, selected work, links and a contact form.
- [Privacy](https://ayushsharma.me/privacy): What this site collects and why.
- [Terms](https://ayushsharma.me/terms): Terms of use.

## Projects

- [Transcoder](https://transcode.procd.cc/): Upload a video, get back adaptive HLS from 144p to 4K with AI captions in two languages. No ffmpeg, no infra to babysit.
- [Pluck](https://pluck.procd.cc/): Give a model the page, not the HTML. Any URL comes back as clean markdown or JSON matching a schema you describe.
- [huddle](https://huddle.procd.cc/): Team chat you run yourself. Channels, threads, files, voice notes, search and calls, in one container and a Postgres.
- [Knox](https://knox.procd.cc/): Real VS Code in your browser, open in one click, no install. Plus a code-execution API for running untrusted code from your own apps.
